== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Rodian (Japanese)|Rodian]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/160005379/rYRKRVEYmke1A8DEnT4F8A.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 93071763.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>3b57cc5b861fb1ebbb92eccf959dd4d0216de37073a66c13dc34a49263d11dbd</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
